en.focus: A daily BTC/ETH/SOL swing-analysis agent that only analyzes — no order authority — with forecasts appended to a log and scored by a script. Alongside it, a personal dashboard that stays behind zero-trust access.
en.focusBrief: BTC/ETH/SOL analysis agent, no order authority
en.researching: Whether crypto trend-following edge is decaying. In backtests written up through 2026-09, a simple BTC breakout system's per-trade expectancy fell from +3.35R on the full sample to +0.93R after 2021-08, and adding more coins made the portfolio worse, not better.
en.watching: Spot-ETF flows as an independent check on price moves. As of 2026-09-25 the data pipe was built but not fed by a live data key, so this is a hypothesis to test, not a signal.
en.watchingBrief: ETF flows: a hypothesis, not a signal

zh.focus: 搭建每日运行的 BTC/ETH/SOL 波段分析 Agent：只分析、没有下单权限，预测只追加进记录并由脚本打分。同时维护一套放在零信任访问之后的个人看板。
zh.researching: 加密市场的趋势跟随优势是不是在衰减。在写到 2026-09 的回测里，一个简单 BTC 突破系统的单笔期望从全样本的 +3.35R 降到 2021-08 之后的 +0.93R；币种铺得越多，组合反而越差。
zh.watching: 把现货 ETF 资金流当作价格变动的独立核对。截至 2026-09-25，数据管道已经搭好，但还没有接上实际的数据 key，所以目前只是待检验的假设，不是信号。
zh.watchingBrief: ETF 资金流：假设，不是信号
